evidence.snippet: No, the access to Freshdesk APIs and the integration capabilities is not available in the free Sprout plan.

decisions.reason: API access is explicitly withheld on the free/Sprout tier and only unlocked on a paid plan (Blossom/Growth onwards), making paid_plan the real blocker to self-serve building.

evidence.snippet: It will be available from the Blossom plan onwards.
For all trial users, there is a default API limit of 50 calls/minute.

decisions.reason: A documented REST API with API-key auth exists, but it is gated behind a paid plan (not the free tier) so building is possible yet with a paid-plan caveat.

evidence.snippet: The Freshworks Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI tools like Cursor and Claude to securely connect and interact with Freshdesk.

decisions.reason: The only officially verifiable vendor MCP server documentation among the provided pages is this Freshworks support article describing the built-in MCP endpoint at https://<subdomain>.freshdesk.com/mcp; the freshworks.com/freshdesk/omni/mcp/ URL cited by agent2 is not among the provided pages so cannot be used as sourced evidence.
